finance.actionsHint: Click a row to edit. Receive and delete right here. The person's record still holds their full history.
finance.alreadyPaid: Already received — records it as paid, dated today
finance.bulkCancelText: {{count}} charge becomes cancelled: it leaves what is due. Payments already recorded stay where they are.

finance.bulkReopenText: {{count}} cancelled charge counts again and comes back to what is due.
finance.bulkReopenText_plural: {{count}} cancelled charges count again and come back to what is due.
finance.canceledHint: Voided entry: it does not count as received and stays in the history. Different from refunded, which is money that came in and went back.
finance.cardLoadFailed: We could not load the cards.
finance.cardMainSet: Done — invoices will be charged to this card.
finance.cardRemoveFailed: We could not remove the card.

finance.cardSaveFailed: We could not store the card.

finance.cardWhyNoGateway: This person's unit has no active payment gateway — without one there is nowhere to store the card.

finance.cardsHint: Stored cards pay the invoices the business issues for this person on their own.
finance.changeDueDateText: The new date applies here and on the gateway invoice, when there is one.
finance.chargeAtGatewayDone: Charge created at the gateway — the payment link is on its row.

finance.chargeGatewayFailedShort: The gateway did not accept the charge.
finance.chargeOnCardHint: Pick the card that pays the {{valor}} of this charge. It settles here when the gateway confirms.
finance.chargedOnCard: The saved card was charged. It settles here when the gateway confirms.
finance.deleteChargeText: The charge goes from here, and the gateway invoice is deleted too when there is one. Only charges with no money received can be deleted.
finance.deletePaymentText: The payment goes, with its receipt. This cannot be undone.
finance.deleteRecurrenceText: Stops generating from now on. Charges already generated remain.
finance.emailFailed: The e-mail could not be sent.
finance.emptyHint: This person's charges and payments show up here.
finance.fileFailed: That file could not be read.

finance.installmentActionFailed: I could not undo this instalment plan.
finance.installmentAtGatewayHint: {{nome}} creates one invoice per installment and sends the link. Without this, the installments exist here only.

finance.installmentDeleteText: The instalments disappear from here and their invoices stop existing at the gateway. This cannot be undone.
finance.installmentFailed: Could not create the installment plan.
finance.installmentGatewayFailed: The installments were created here, but the gateway refused: {{erro}}

finance.installmentPreviewFirst: {{parcelas}}× {{valor}} — the first one is {{primeira}}, carrying the leftover cents
finance.loadFailed: Could not load the finance data.
finance.looseHint: Came in with no charge on the other side: advance, one-off sale, or a charge deleted later.

finance.noCardsHint: With a card here, the membership fee is charged without anyone paying by hand.
finance.noInstallmentHint: Split an amount into several payments and they are all created at once, with their dates.
finance.noLoose: No loose payments — everything received is tied to a charge.
finance.noRecurrenceHint: Subscribe to a plan and the system generates the charge on its own, on the right day.
finance.pendingHint: Not received yet — does not count toward the balance.
finance.recurrenceAmountFromPlan: The amount comes from the chosen plan.
finance.recurrenceAtGatewayHint: Every charge this subscription creates is born with an invoice at {{nome}} — a link ready to send, and automatic settlement when the money lands.
finance.recurrenceHint: The plan the person subscribes to — monthly, biannual, yearly. It creates the charge on its own.
finance.recurrenceNameFromPlan: Empty: each charge takes the plan's name.
finance.recurrenceNameHint: This is the name each generated charge will carry.
finance.recurrenceNoChargesHint: The first one appears when the first due date arrives.

finance.refundText: The gateway returns the full amount to the payer. This cannot be undone.
finance.refundedHint: Returned — does not count toward the balance.
finance.saveCardForNextHint: What stays is a single-use code — never the card number.
finance.sendByEmailText: The person gets the payment link at the e-mail on file.
finance.sendLinkText: Hi! Here is the link to pay: {{link}}
finance.statusHint: Paid is not a choice: it happens when payments cover the amount.
finance.statusPaidHint: Payments already cover the amount — the list shows it as Paid.

gatewayLog.title: What Asaas sent
gatewayLog.explain: Everything the gateway reported in the last 30 days, and what was done with each notice. This is where the three questions get answered when money does not show up on a profile: did it arrive? was it accepted? did it match a charge?
gatewayLog.emptyHint: When the gateway reports a payment, the row appears here.
gatewayLog.search: Search by invoice id or event
gatewayLog.loadFailed: I could not load the notices.

ajuda.aplicado: It arrived, the secret matched, and the notice changed something here.
ajuda.ignorado: It arrived intact and matched no charge on this side. This is the case nobody suspects on their own: an invoice created outside the system, or a charge deleted after the slip went out.
ajuda.recusado: The token in the header is not the one stored here. Save the gateway key again under Payment gateways — that rewrites the webhook there with the right secret.
ajuda.erro: Our fault. Asaas resends anything that did not answer 2xx, so this one usually resolves itself on the next try.
